What I also really appreciate is how attentive she is throughout the grooming process. She sends photos and videos showing what she’s doing, which makes me feel completely comfortable and involved. I took my Phalène to this groomer and I am extremely disappointed with the result.

What makes this even more frustrating is that I clearly said beforehand that I usually do not cut her back coat. The groomer even asked again, and I trusted her professional judgment.

Despite this, the entire topcoat on her back was cut very short and evenly shaved down. This completely removed the natural, silky coat that is characteristic for this breed and left her with a flat, plush-like appearance.

For a Phalène, this is absolutely not appropriate. The topcoat has an important protective function and should not be cut like this.

I also contacted the breeder afterwards, who was shocked and confirmed that this should never happen. A professional groomer should know how to handle breed-specific coat types.

Because of this, there is now a real risk that the coat will grow back unevenly or with a different texture, and her skin is much more exposed.

I explicitly trusted a professional here, and that trust was clearly misplaced.
